title: review: Polish: scorecard.parallelism critical_path_s ignores tasks without durations unless they sit on the longest path; baseline parallelism deltas treat a missing skip_reasons key as zero
spec:
Goal T-0503 polish from review T-0515 (findings on S0b, already merged). Base goal/T-0503 (head be0e82b). Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only. Tests are unittest.TestCase methods.
Finding 1 (high): scorecard.parallelism sets critical_path_s to undefined whenever ANY execute task of the goal lacks a defined execution duration (longest() propagates None through the whole DP and paths[gid] requires every value defined), so one in-flight or unstamped task hides the whole goal's critical path. Fix: compute the longest path over the DAG using only tasks with a defined execution_s as nodes with weight; a task without a duration is skipped as a node but still lets the path pass through it with weight 0 only if it is merged (done) and merely unstamped (legacy); tasks still running or queued (no gated_at and not merged) are excluded from the DAG entirely; critical_path_s is undefined only when no task of the goal has a defined duration. Add "critical_path_tasks" (count of tasks on the reported path) and "critical_path_partial" (true when any goal task was excluded for a missing duration) to the per-goal metrics and the table.
Finding 2 (med): baseline._parallelism_deltas treats a skip_reasons key missing from one snapshot as None (undefined). A reason absent from the dict means zero occurrences, so default missing skip_reasons keys to 0 on both sides before computing the delta; keep undefined only for metrics whose value is None.
Tests: tests/test_scorecard.py::test_parallelism_critical_path_ignores_unstamped_tasks_off_the_path, tests/test_scorecard.py::test_parallelism_critical_path_partial_flag; tests/test_baseline.py::test_parallelism_deltas_missing_skip_reason_is_zero. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_scorecard.py::test_parallelism_critical_path_ignores_unstamped_tasks_off_the_path passes: a goal with one in-flight unstamped task off the longest path still reports critical_path_s and critical_path_partial true

tests/test_scorecard.py::test_parallelism_critical_path_partial_flag and tests/test_baseline.py::test_parallelism_deltas_missing_skip_reason_is_zero pass: a skip reason present only in the after snapshot shows before 0, not undefined
full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 and the suite gains three tests
